verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is a chat-first personal assistant: you chat with it from messaging channels such as Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord and iMessage. Those natural-language requests drive real actions through its shell, browser and computer-use tools. Hands-on reports corroborate this, including a user who delegated a full home-lab setup conversationally and another running nine agents with scheduled tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the product's own setup and administration (config, skills, channels) can be done in natural language rather than through the CLI, config files or slash commands like `/model`.
